$comment: Tenant-level demo data. Dates are offsets from the moment the seed runs, never absolute, so a demo rehearsed in September still looks alive in December.

settings.note: Synthetic tenant. is_demo drives the DEMO DATA marker; nothing here describes a real school.

$levels: Thresholds are product parameters tuned during the pilot, not design constants (DESIGN_SYSTEM.md section 9). These are set so that one pilot quarter can actually span all four tiers: attendance alone puts Bayani fifteen events away, while organizing and volunteering get there much faster, which is the behaviour the economy is meant to reward. hiraya-gamification-balancer revisits them against real data.
$xpRules: The PRD FR-5 starting values, unchanged. The demo must not quietly invent a different economy from the one the pitch describes.
